Beauty Treatments

Manicure

Time Price
01:00 Hours 600 Baht

Manicure involves treatment of the nails and cuticles. We offer OPI Nail polish. Gel or acrylic nails are not offered. Currently only available at the Old City branch. For gel nail removal, an additional charge of 100 THB will apply. Please note that we do not offer services for acrylic nails.

Manicure with Gel Polish

Time Price
01:30 Hours 900 Baht

Manicure involves treatment of the nails and cuticles. We offer Gel Nail Polish. Currently only available at the Old City branch. Please note that we do not offer services for acrylic nails.

Pedicure

Time Price
01:00 Hours 600 Baht

A pedicure includes a treatment of the nails and cuticles. We perform a short gentle foot scrub but if you would like to have the tough skin on your heels and feet removed, please book an Exfoliating Foot scrub in addition to the pedicure. Currently only available at the Old City branch.

Pedicure with Gel Polish

Time Price
01:30 Hours 900 Baht

A pedicure includes a treatment of the nails and cuticles. We perform a short gentle foot scrub but if you would like to have the tough skin on your heels and feet removed, please book an Exfoliating Foot scrub in addition to the pedicure. Currently only available at the Old City branch.We use Gel Nail Polish.

Aromatic Herbal Steam

Time Price
00:30 Hours 850 Baht

The Aromatic Herbal Steam opens skin pores and decongests the lungs as you relax and rejuvenate in our Lanna Steam Room. The 30-minute option is available only as an add-on to another treatment and cannot be booked separately. The minimum booking duration is 60 minutes.

Fah Lanna Royal Bath

Time Price
00:30 Hours 850 Baht

Let your muscles relax as you soak in our milky herb infused bath. The 30-minute option is available only as an add-on to another treatment and cannot be booked separately. The minimum booking duration is 60 minutes.

Exfoliating Foot Scrub

Time Price
01:00 Hours 1,000 Baht

A scrub that removes dead and hard skin leaving your feet soft and smooth.

Facial Treatment

Time Price
01:00 Hours 1,500 Baht

This five step facial treatment consists of cleansing the skin, a gentle natural scrub, a facial massage, a natural mask, and a natural moisturizing treatment. It cleans and revitalizes your skin leaving it fresh, smooth and glowing.

Body Scrub

Time Price
01:00 Hours 1,500 Baht

This natural body scrub exfoliates by removing dead skin cells, oils and toxins that the skin does not allow to pass through. It stimulates the skin and improves circulation which is believed to have a positive effect on the body’s immune system. Your skin will feel replenished, soft and smooth.

Body Mask

Time Price
01:00 Hours 1,500 Baht

A mask infused with herb- and plant extracts applied to your body to detoxify the skin, leaving it feel fresher, softer and smoother.
